shape: two people in an ordinary moment; one finally says the thing they never said

slides.text: you were standing by the garden shop counter, holding a small tray of yellow pansies.
i almost turned back to the potting soil, sure you only remembered the kid who spilled glue on the rug.
so i stepped closer and asked if room four still smelled like damp wool on rainy mornings.
but you set the tray down, looked over your glasses, and asked if i still kept three pencils in my coat.
so we stood by the seed packets for ten minutes while the rain tapped on the glass roof.
i told you i spent that whole year sure i was the hardest student you had to manage.
you looked down at your shoes and said [[ you put my desk by the window on purpose ]], so i could watch the birds whenever the room got too loud.

caption:
some people gave us a quiet spot before we even knew we were overwhelmed.
they noticed which corner helped us get through the hour.
send this to the teacher who made the room feel a little safer.

#childhoodmemories #schoolmemories #teacher #growingup
alt: A story post about running into an old teacher in a garden shop and learning why they placed your desk by the window.
